card.name: The word infusion before reaction
card.fires_on: The word infusion (or Infusion) right before a hyphen or the word reaction, as in infusion-related reactions. Also fires weakly on a space after 'more than' and on 'yield' before 'losses'.

modes.label: Infusion-related reactions
modes.description: The word infusion or its start, placed just before -related or -associated reactions in warnings and adverse reaction text.
modes.example: If a severe<< infusion>>-related reaction occurs, discontinue IMA

modes.label: Other noun before a loss or amount
modes.description: Scattered cases such as a space after 'more than' before a dose amount, or 'yield' before losses.
